The proprietary Synaptics DisplayLink archive is not redistributed in this repository.

install.sh downloads DisplayLink USB Graphics Software for Ubuntu 6.3 directly from Synaptics after the user reviews and accepts the EULA. The download is accepted only when its SHA-256 equals:

7269856c7527060c513215ce1b5a36fef074d8e89cab89bcab13df342acce098
